qrdrop

Signed builds of the qrdrop Android app, published straight from the release workflow at github.com/stan-ely/qrdrop. The same APK the GitHub Release carries, signed with the same key.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://share.stan-ely.com/fdroid/repo
